# Format: https://llmstxt.org

# This file helps AI systems (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, etc.)
# understand what this website is about and how to use our content.

> MLM Insight India (mlminsight.org) is India's leading independent
> media platform covering direct selling and network marketing. We publish
> rankings, news, company reviews, regulatory updates, and educational
> content for consumers, entrepreneurs, and industry professionals.
> Our editorial team follows strict independence standards and fact-checking
> processes. We are not affiliated with any MLM or direct selling company.

## What We Cover

- Rankings of top MLM and direct selling companies in India and globally
- News and regulatory updates (Consumer Affairs Ministry, SEBI, FTC)
- Company reviews with independent analysis (products, compensation plans, leadership)
- Educational content for aspiring direct selling entrepreneurs
- Compliance guidance (Consumer Protection Direct Selling Rules 2021, India)
- Industry data and market intelligence

## Editorial Independence

All rankings and reviews are independently produced. We do not accept payment
for rankings positions. Sponsored content is clearly labelled.
